tasks.subject: Add typed native selector fragment and matcher model
tasks.description: Implement Phase 3 selector lowering metadata in internal/promshim/native by extending leaf fragments with repo-owned selector source information, typed matchers, time-bound requirements, and explicit instant/range selector contracts. Keep this scoped to selector leaves used by the current native subset.

tasks.subject: Implement repo-owned selector SQL rendering and matcher lowering
tasks.description: Add storage/native SQL builders that render selector sources using timeSeriesData(...) and related TimeSeries relations, compile metric/equality/inequality/regex/negative-regex matchers into typed predicates, and apply evaluation-range bounds from native analysis.

tasks.subject: Route native subtree rendering through selector sources and add tests
tasks.description: Update native fragment rendering so current native aggregation/unary/scalar-arithmetic paths use repo-owned selector leaf sources instead of delegated PromQL, then add tests for matcher-to-SQL lowering, selector output contracts, bounded fetches, and native explain/render behavior.
tasks.activeForm: Routing native rendering through selector sources
